sentences: This describes a Variant entity in the domain.
The Variant record participates in downstream tool operations.
Variant.item_id: Unique identifier for the variant
Variant.options: Dictionary of option names to values (e.g. {'color': 'blue', 'size': 'large'})
Variant.available: Whether this variant is currently in stock
Variant.price: Price of this variant
This describes a Product entity in the domain.
The Product record participates in downstream tool operations.
Product.name: Name of the product
Product.product_id: Unique identifier for the product
Product.variants: Dictionary of variants indexed by variant ID
This describes a UserName entity in the domain.
The UserName record participates in downstream tool operations.
UserName.first_name: User's first name
UserName.last_name: User's last name
This describes a UserAddress entity in the domain.
The UserAddress record participates in downstream tool operations.
UserAddress.address1: Primary address line
UserAddress.address2: Secondary address line
UserAddress.city: City name
UserAddress.country: Country name
This describes a PaymentMethodBase entity in the domain.
The PaymentMethodBase record participates in downstream tool operations.
PaymentMethodBase.source: Type of payment method
PaymentMethodBase.id: Unique identifier for the payment method
A CreditCard is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The CreditCard record participates in downstream tool operations.
CreditCard.source: Indicates this is a credit card payment method
CreditCard.brand: Credit card brand (e.g., visa, mastercard)
CreditCard.last_four: Last four digits of the credit card
A Paypal is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The Paypal record participates in downstream tool operations.
Paypal.source: Indicates this is a paypal payment method
A GiftCard is a kind of PaymentMethodBase.
The GiftCard record participates in downstream tool operations.
GiftCard.source: Indicates this is a gift card payment method
GiftCard.balance: Gift card value amount
GiftCard.id: Unique identifier for the gift card
This describes a User entity in the domain.
The User record participates in downstream tool operations.
User.user_id: Unique identifier for the user
User.name: User's full name
User.address: User's primary address
User.email: User's email address
This describes a OrderFullfilment entity in the domain.
The OrderFullfilment record participates in downstream tool operations.
OrderFullfilment.tracking_id: List of tracking IDs for shipments
OrderFullfilment.item_ids: List of item IDs included in this fulfillment
This describes a OrderItem entity in the domain.
The OrderItem record participates in downstream tool operations.
OrderItem.name: Name of the product
OrderItem.product_id: ID of the product
OrderItem.item_id: ID of the specific variant
OrderItem.price: Price of the item at time of purchase
This describes a OrderPayment entity in the domain.
The OrderPayment record participates in downstream tool operations.
OrderPayment.transaction_type: Type of transaction (payment or refund)
OrderPayment.amount: Amount of the transaction
OrderPayment.payment_method_id: ID of the payment method used
This describes a BaseOrder entity in the domain.
The BaseOrder record participates in downstream tool operations.
BaseOrder.order_id: Unique identifier for the order
BaseOrder.user_id: Unique identifier for the user
BaseOrder.address: Address of the user
BaseOrder.items: Items in the order
This describes a Order entity in the domain.
The Order record participates in downstream tool operations.
Order.order_id: Unique identifier for the order
Order.user_id: Unique identifier for the user
Order.address: Address of the user
Order.items: Items in the order
This describes a RetailDB entity in the domain.
The RetailDB record participates in downstream tool operations.
RetailDB.products: Dictionary of all products indexed by product ID
RetailDB.users: Dictionary of all users indexed by user ID
RetailDB.orders: Dictionary of all orders indexed by order ID
